comments.name: Global_Vision
comments.content: Okay, the US CPI data is a real shocker, especially the core inflation! This definitely puts a lot of pressure back on the Fed for a potential October hike, which will strengthen the dollar even more. Paul Tudor Jones's comparison to the dot-com bubble is concerning for tech stocks, especially after seeing CoreWeave and the chip index plunge. But on the flip side, China's September data is looking quite robust, especially the export growth and the surge in integrated circuit exports. This suggests a strong rebound in manufacturing and global trade, which is a positive divergence. It's a truly mixed bag globally.
